verdicts.why: After faults at each possible publish write, the check asserts that the complete pointer history and raw rows are unchanged and that the previous pointer remains latest, detecting either a stray new pointer or premature supersession. Its successful control then asserts that the previous pointer becomes superseded while the new pointer becomes published.
